'''Brian Keith Bosworth''' (born March 9, 1965) is an American actor and former professional [[American football|football]] [[linebacker]] who played in the [[National Football League]] (NFL) for three seasons with the [[Seattle Seahawks]]. Nicknamed "'''the Boz'''", he played [[college football]] for the [[Oklahoma Sooners football|Oklahoma Sooners]], earning two [[Dick Butkus Award]]s and winning the [[1986 Orange Bowl]]. Bosworth was selected by the Seahawks in the first round of the [[1987 NFL Draft|1987 NFL supplemental draft]], but his professional career was cut short by injury. After retiring as a player, Bosworth pursued an acting career. He was inducted into the [[College Football Hall of Fame]] in 2015.
